name: Crimes Against Anatomy
summary: A librarian asks you to add magical works to a library's collection. Your discoveries help expand the library’s knowledge.

sections.title: For the Collection
sections.body: Any work of magic that could serve the library is welcome there. You can bring discoveries to the librarian, whose knowledge grows through these contributions. More works may yet be of use to the library.

faq.answer: A librarian asks you to bring magical works that could benefit the collection.

faq.q: Where do I bring the works?
faq.answer: Bring them to the librarian. Librarians gather such works in Stormwind and in the Undercity.
The works help expand the library’s knowledge.
